photos.caption: Original 1929 archival photograph of the 36-story Art Deco Gulf Building upon completion (Alfred C. Finn, Kenneth Franzheim & J.E.R. Carpenter).

photos.credit: Wikimedia Commons / Public Domain (1927)

photos.caption: Texas Avenue streetscape showing the Rice Hotel with early automobiles and streetcars.

photos.caption: Present-day view of the Rice Hotel (The Rice) after adaptive reuse and restoration.

photos.caption: Houston Union Station upon its 1911 opening, designed by Warren & Wetmore (architects of New York's Grand Central Terminal).

photos.caption: Restored Beaux-Arts limestone colonnade of Union Station serving as the grand entrance to the ballpark.

photos.caption: Crawford Street elevation of historic Union Station in 2020.

photos.caption: Houston City Hall (Joseph Finger, 1939) and Hermann Square reflecting pool in 1981.
